domain: 125 one-variable equations on {-2,-1,0,1,2}; 729 two-row systems on {-1,0,1} plus 3 rational cases; 25 candidate pairs per system
oracle: SymPy 1.14.0 exact solveset/rank/inverse, direct Fraction substitution
explicit_examples: zero one-variable coefficient: identity and contradiction distinguished
both zero rows: all pairs or contradiction
zero scalar combination: inconsistent and dependent consistent distinguished
zero first coefficient uses a nonzero second-coordinate pivot
first zero row is swapped with the nonzero row
unique pair checked in both original equations
limits: Finite external checks, not proofs. Solvers cover all rational unknowns only; extra domain exclusions are not parsed or imposed.
